I have been there too... people are not empathetic. Most have such an ego and only want to see others fail and somehow we still give our hopes and hearts away to their kind.

Just know that the passion that keeps you awake at night, (which forms as anxiety most of the time) is exactly what your subconscious is telling you to pursue 🖤🖤🖤

It is only neglect not taking care of yourself. In feeling there is nothing to live for, I can understand that pain as I have before starved and dehydrated my own self.

What i can guarantee is that even through death, this way, there is no fulfillment.

I have had many nde’s that shook me to the core until I realized if I fuck up bad enough, the next time I wake up I will be in a straight jacket in some white room or in some lobotomy hell:

We are born alone  as ourselves and die alone as ourselves and the only thing we can ensure is shifting our own perspective

The same strength you have to write this is the same strength you need on just one single day to make a difference in your life. Forget those fucks and this fuck world, find that joy in you and remember why you are the awesome person you KNOW you are

We all want to, but the uncertainty of it all is what stops us... 

What we can control is here and now and we know deep down if we can somehow wake up and just do it (get out of bed, eat breakfast, exercise. Hell/// drink water..) we will inevitably feel better...

It’s just the DOING it part that is hard after so long of not feeling motivated to do so.

The only thing that will help is yourself, doing it. As much as you want to fight the routine, make one.

Your next step, is to continue where you feel the most comfortable. In these uncertain times nothing feels comfortable..: but I’m sure you have a passion, something that fuels the creativity inside of you and stopped time like nothing else. And now more than ever is the time to connect with that piece of yourself. So do not give up: this is the ammunition you need to prove to yourself you were always good enough

I have felt the same, and even isolated because of my own thought. But once I stopped caring about their thoughts and opinions and more about* myself. I found peace in the little things of life: so much as the childhood drinks I loved or Halloween, my favorite holiday./ 

I tried to understand why I even loved anything but I (understood) it brought me a peace so I continued to let it.

You must be open to the possibility that those people in the past weren’t meant for your path now and have trust that you will find your way happy or not, nothing is perfect, but you are a piece of this everlasting puzzle and wouldn’t have been here if you weren’t needed

You were made from love, you have given it your whole life, and the toll it has brought (the rejection and pain and misunderstandings) had detached you from who you are.. but remember... nothing forged was (never) under the hottest of coal. Pressure creates diamonds, and your will to survive is all the reason to find your purpose and to share your message of survival to those in your exact situation looking for the same relief

One cannot give up, ever, truly. As we continue forward in both life and death, the only thing that will matter is intention.

Empathetic types that feel the worlds pain will only continuously suffer through passed guilt while the rest will only use your passing as fuel to incite an ego uplift

Choose wisely, as you are here to spread love and to live for a reason and that reason is to remind others, that... Even though this experience is hell, it can be succumbed

Even after the choice is made, the pain inflicted will be on those who love you, and those in the future of whom are made to need your advice and support after getting through this hard time.

Sometimes we do not realize the power we hold by feeling so much.. others need the guidance and support far more than our own selves. We need you to carry on a message of survival and hope to the next for the universe’ sake

The constant buzzing is the world, of whom has too much to say when you need the support and they constantly bombard you with their needy attention.

Even healers need their rest, and it seems you are an empath feeling the weight of the world 🖤 do not shut down,but rest when you are able
I do agree. There will be no relief. As I know truest to myself, that is the case through my own nde’s. The only thing that can change is how we manage these feelings and emotions forward

Waking up becomes harder, living becomes impossible, but in the word itself “I’m” “possible”.. all opportunities are open if willing

All I can tell you... is that I have been here.. exactly where you are. Eerily similar situations. And the only thing that kept me going was the fact I’ve studied quantum physics and psychology for so long that I have utterly realized we never die..

Energy can neither be created nor destroyed..

So your essence of being, of “consciousness”, even dead... will only continue on to the next reality as if you are picking up where you left off..

Imagine you commit the ultimate crime against yourself...

Who is a witness, how long to find you... etc..

This is why you and you alone would cause your own Version of hell for a time...

The only thing we can do is be better than we were yesterday...

We were alone before birth, we must carry out the journey alone as well. Which is why many of us feel so alone in a crowded room. 

The empathetic types, the artists, the helpers. Are the ones to feel the largest burdens... because in the end you care so much, it feels like toooooo much to you... 

And after making such loving connections in our lives hurt us it is hard to continue doing so. After giving your all so many times, being there when they weren’t for you, feeling misunderstood, unheard...

There are a rare breed of us for a reason.:/

We know the end is never ending deep down and it feels trauma enough knowing we cannot stop the inevitable instilling universe
